title: OC-DESIGN-TYPE-001: Product-wide OpsControl typography design system
body:
## Goal

Create one **distinctive, standardized and accessible typography system** for the whole OpsControl product, after Sprint 1's accepted Resource Management visual baseline. Keep the system uniform across current/future desktop workspaces, Overview/KPIs, ETL Jobs, VM Health, APIs, resource details, filters, forms, tables, history/revisions, alerts/status, accessible navigation and responsive layouts.

## Owner decision (2026-11-09)

- PR #89 **Resource Management visual candidate accepted**; typography modernization is a **separate follow-up** and not a reason to retroactively deny that acceptance.
- **Typography font choice and exact scale are NOT YET approved**; bring a small comparative specimen/decision memo for owner sign-off before changing product styles.
- Keep #89 draft and security/CI/independent-approval gates separate. No merge/deployment/release authorization.

## Evidence to ground design

- On PR #89 source `54f26e51106469e285dd747dd6b8afd09ca43ce6`, `frontend/src/styles.css` declares `Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif` globally, but no `@font-face`/`@import` was present in that inspected stylesheet, nor a font load in `frontend/index.html`. Confirm all source files and actual computed browser fonts before concluding whether Inter is present on machines.
- The inspected stylesheet has 139 declarations involving font family/size/weight/line-height/tracking, with many hard-coded 9/10/11/12px sizes alongside 13/15/20/26/28/30px. A complete inventory should also include `resource-v2.css` and all component inline styles.
- Existing owner-accepted captures: `docs/verification/sprint1-integration/VISUAL_ACCEPTANCE.md` (admin/operator at 1920×1080, 1440×900, 1366×768); reference screenshot under `docs/design/references/`.

## Proposed design system (for owner review, NOT approval)

- **Candidate signature:** IBM Plex Sans for UI + IBM Plex Mono for hostnames/technical identifiers. Compare against Inter (current declared fallback) and one other licensed sans option in a neutral specimen; do not claim IBM Plex was chosen by owner.
- Tokenized roles: product/display 32–36px; page heading 26–28px; section heading 20–22px; card heading 16–18px; primary body/fields 14–16px; secondary/metadata 12–13px where readable; KPI number 28–36px with tabular numerals; fixed-width logs/code/IDs 12–14px. Final sizes depend on viewport/readability testing, not this draft.
- Use CSS custom properties for families, type scale, weights, line heights and tracking. Supply semantic class/components (page-title, section-title, body, label, metric, metadata, code) and stop page-local divergent font rules.
- Test 100%/125%/150%/200% zoom, dark/light, 1366/1440/1920 desktop, long server names and values, non-Latin fallback, screen-reader semantics, keyboard/focus, no clipped controls, stable data-table alignment and reduced layout shift.
- Verify self-hosted fonts and exact font licensing/NOTICE; avoid runtime external font-CDN dependency, avoid sharing font binaries in handoffs.

## Codex deliverables — OC-DESIGN-TYPE-001

1. Inventory every font declaration/inline style/source import and computed rendering in the current product, with screenshot evidence.
2. Produce 2–3 side-by-side typography specimens against the approved screenshot, and a design decision record for owner choice.
3. Once the owner approves a candidate, implement a reusable global typography token layer and migrate pages incrementally in a **dedicated branch/PR** rather than intermixing with PR #89 security-blocker remediation.
4. Add lint/policy regression against new arbitrary font sizes/families, visual regressions at approved viewports, zoom/focus tests, and accessible table/KPI/label snapshots.
5. Include licensing/provenance manifest, screenshots, performance/fonts fallback evidence, rollout/rollback and reviewed CSS change inventory.
6. Obtain owner typography sign-off and independent review, with all relevant CI enforced. Do not weaken the release gates.

## Out of scope

No change to collector, telemetry semantics, API permissions, incident exclusion, data migrations, security findings, or branch-protection rules. No implementation until owner selects typography direction.
